verdict.rationale: Code Connect maps design-system components in code to Figma components so Dev Mode shows true-to-production snippets instead of autogenerated code, with a React/React Native guide and a CLI (figma-gh-3, figma-docs-60, figma-probe-4). The MCP server separately turns selected frames into code and uses Code Connect to keep that output consistent with the codebase (figma-docs-39, figma-docs-25, figma-docs-35). A community report says default autogenerated CSS falls back to absolute positioning (figma-comm-1), which caveats non-mapped output but does not contradict Code Connect. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that generated or mapped code ships as-is, and evidence of framework coverage beyond React.
